column1: # xlang Capstone column — PREDICTIONS, committed BEFORE the runs.
# This file is the reason the column is a test rather than a description. The
# CHERI column did the same (../cheri/rows.tsv) and all 14 predictions held;
# predicting after the fact proves nothing.
# Configs. Capstone has two that map onto CHERI's three:
#   bounds   = spatial only, no revocation      <-> CHERI "spatial"
#   revoke   = revoke-on-free                   <-> CHERI "eager"
# There is NO Capstone analogue of CHERI's async quarantine default. That is a
# fact about the mechanisms, reported rather than papered over.
# Only the `revoke` config is predicted and run here; `bounds` needs a
# non-revoking arena allocator that does not exist yet.
# expect_revoke:
#   FAULT   the stale access is prevented (abort on cincoffset, or a delivered
#           cause-24/25 monitor fault -- both count as prevented; see the
#           2026-08-01 history note on why the manifestation differs)
#   MISS    the stale access completes and the row reports
#           "use-after-free-survived"
#   INVALID the harness could not measure the row (arena depleted, realloc grew
#           in place). NOT a verdict.
# control (XLANG_NO_REVOKE) must be MISS for every temporal row, or that row's
# FAULT is not attributable to the revoke and must not be scored.
